description: This file defines a PHP class 'ShippingMethod' within the 'Opencart\Catalog\Controller\Api\Sale' namespace. The class handles API requests related to shipping methods during a sale, including listing available shipping options and saving a selected shipping method. It interacts with session data, models, and provides JSON responses for API clients.

classes.name: ShippingMethod
classes.description: Controller class for handling shipping method API endpoints in the OpenCart system.

methods.name: index
methods.description: Handles retrieving available shipping methods or returning errors if no shipping address is set.

methods.name: save
methods.description: Handles saving the selected shipping method, updating session data, and returning success or error messages.
